plan.rationale: We are dispatching D1 to the Washington and Battery Streets collapse cluster (447 Battery St, 401 Washington St, 425 Washington St) where survivors have been spotted on the rubble, while also resolving the damage discrepancy at nearby One Maritime Plaza along the route. D2 will sweep the unscanned FiDi URM-infill block at One Sansome Street, which holds ~9,000 occupants and has a 65% predicted collapse risk. D3 is held in reserve for follow-up tasking and emerging reports.

missions.purpose: Confirm collapse severity and locate trapped survivors at Washington/Battery rubble piles, plus verify One Maritime Plaza damage.
Survey the unscanned One Sansome Street URM-infill block for catastrophic collapse among its 9,000 occupants.

plan.rationale: In this final wave, we are deploying all three remaining drones to resolve critical life-safety questions and sweep high-occupancy unscanned blocks. D1 will verify trapped survivors and active fire along the California and Pine corridor, D2 will resolve high-occupancy damage disagreements near Embarcadero Center and the Federal Reserve, and D3 will survey unscanned high-risk blocks at Rincon Annex and the Pacific Gas & Electric Building. No drones are held in reserve as this is the final wave and AIR 1 has completed its scan.

missions.purpose: Assess fire at 201 California St and confirm trapped survivors at 100 Battery, 433 California, and California Bank and Trust.
Resolve damage disagreements and check for trapped occupants at Embarcadero Center 3, Hyatt Regency, Federal Reserve, and Matson Building.
Survey unscanned, densely occupied structures at Rincon Annex and the SoMa steel block at Pacific Gas & Electric Building.
